message.body:
Hello Mr Lis,

You wrote that you are eager to prove yourselves as a long-term partner, and the options below are built for exactly that: steady work on Bearing bracket HN, with quality terms that are clear and a price that works for both sides.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

Option A is the package we can approve. It matches the quality level your parts have actually delivered, and it removes the chargeback, so there is no deduction to argue about on either side.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. We will pay every invoice on its agreed due date.

Best regards

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

I am dropping the price to 46.50 EUR to reflect the past prices you mentioned. We can do your Option A with the 1500 ppm target and zero chargebacks. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Thanks for confirming you will pay exactly on the due date, this is super important for us to keep things running smoothly. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net, but faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Our current offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.50 per unit (a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint). This proposal is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
